records.trigger: PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED is off when unset, so future DONE stories do not automatically write learning settlement rows.
records.observedFailure: playbook_promotion_status reports PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED.enabled=false with an empty raw value; unset configuration disables settlement instead of recording learning health by default.
records.note: Current live CLI status is the red behavior; after the fix, unset env should be enabled while explicit opt-out remains disabled.
